description: Lists the Notion AI meeting notes the DataToRAG connection can read, the newest at the top, created on or after a date and optionally on or before another, and optionally only those whose title contains some text. Each note carries its id, title, the meeting's start and end time, attendee_count, its status, the AI summary and the notes as text, and action_items: every to-do in the summary and notes with whether it is checked, and every list item under a heading that says action items or next steps. A note on a private page comes back only once the page is shared with the connection. The transcript is left out unless include_transcript is true. Attendee names are left out unless include_attendees is true: then each note also carries attendees by name and attendees_unnamed, how many could not be named. The workspace's member list is read once, then up to 100 attendees it does not hold are looked up one by one, and those Notion still gives no name for, such as some guests, are counted. The text of one answer is held to max_body_chars together (default 100,000): when there is more, the oldest notes keep their title and times but not their text, and left_out lists their ids. Notion returns at most 50 notes and no cursor; has_more true means more notes match than were returned, and a narrower date range reads the rest. A part the note does not have yet, such as the summary of a meeting not yet transcribed, is null; a part that exists with nothing in it is an empty string. Reading meeting notes through Notion's API needs a Notion plan with AI meeting notes enabled; a workspace whose plan lacks it answers with a sentence saying so.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

include_attendees.description: Whether each note carries its attendees by name. Default false, in which case a note carries attendee_count only and no user is read.

include_transcript.description: Whether each note carries its transcript as text. Default false.

limit.description: How many notes, from 1 to 50. Default 10.

max_body_chars.description: The text of all notes in one answer, together, in characters. Default 100,000, at most 200,000.

since.description: Notes created on or after this day: a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or one of today, yesterday, one_week_ago. Default yesterday.

title.description: Only notes whose title contains this text.

until.description: Notes created on or before this day: a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or one of today, yesterday, one_week_ago. Absent means up to now.

name: notion-mcp__notion_list_meeting_notes
